Regional Workshop-cum-CME on Infertility Recent Updates
Wednesday, 20 January 2016
6398 Hits
Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology , MGIMS, Sevagram  along with Sevagram Wardha Obstetrics & Gynaecology society is going to organize Regional workshop cum CME on Infertility Recent Updates  on 31
st
January 2016.
It is open for Faculty members / Post-graduates / Medical officers / Private Practitioner/ Nursing Students and Faculty /Lab Assistants working in  the field of infertility.
Eminent speakers in the field of infertility will be delivering guest lectures on various aspects of infertility. The star faculty are Dr P Choksi, from Bombay, Dr Laxmi Shrikhande, Dr Chaitanya Shembekar  from Nagpur, Dr Gorakh  Mandrupkar from Islampur and Prof S Chhabra from Sevagram. They will be deliberating on very basic issues like male factor and female factor in infertility. Practical aspects like sperm preparation and instillation techniques will also be dealt with. At the same time latest modalities like imaging and endoscopy in infertilty will be discussed. After this academic feast in the afternoon session a hands on IUI workshop will be conducted by the faculty. The young researchers have also been given a slot in the morning for the poster presentation. The best posters will be given prizes
Interested delegates may please register with organizing team till 25 January 2016.
MMC has awarded 1 credit point for the same.
Faculty members registration is Rs 800
Postgraduates registration is Rs 700
Organizing Chairperson
Prof .S. Chhabra
Dr Poonam Verma Shivkumar
Organizing secretary
Dr Shuchi Jain
Dept of OBGY
MGIMS Sevagram
Contact no for registration 9422141337
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
